validation_notes: Since late June the price has been trading essentially flat/sideways in a narrow range (~0.0044-0.0050) with no meaningful convergence between highs and lows - both the upper and lower boundaries are roughly horizontal, resembling a flat consolidation/rectangle rather than a descending triangle.
